plugins.name: finding-unknowns
plugins.description: One task card per task, kept by you and the agent: you predict first, the agent works quietly and stops only at four checkable points (irreversible step, scope change, dead premise, budget), and a fresh context grades every frozen prediction at the debrief. /fu-brief, /fu-catch-up, /fu-debrief. Measured results use Theory → Measured → Consistent? → Mechanism. Agents: blindspot-scout, mechanism-auditor, quiz-master. Whether this helps people is not yet tested.
